VENDORED, NOT LOADED FROM A CDN, and that is a decision rather than a habit:

· The docs are a static site with no build step of its own and no third-party
  script anywhere else. One CDN tag would make every page load on this site
  depend on a host nobody here controls, for a feature one page uses.
· It is 956 KB — by far the heaviest thing published here. It is loaded from the
  page that needs it (docs/platform/devices.md) with an ordinary relative
  <script type="module">, NOT from mkdocs.yml's extra_javascript, which would put
  it on all 21 pages including the ones that are three paragraphs of prose.
· It comes byte-for-byte from ~/strands-nicla/docs/assets/vendor, where the same
  runtime drives the necklace's own page and its checkers. Same bytes, same
  version, one place to update.

The BSD-3-Clause licence requires this notice and the copyright line above to
travel with the copy, which is why this file sits beside it and is published with
it rather than living in a repo-internal note.
